rules: counts are measured from committed job outputs at repo_head
reach is not yield: orders a unit could advance one step, not orders made ready
AI statuses are hypotheses; no codebook change; no tier promotion; certified stays 0
note: ceiling_orders is not-ready reach (a Domesday-style ceiling), never a forecast; already-ready orders are excluded from it. Reach must not be summed across actions: frames overlap and same_unit_actions lists the same unit under another frame. cost_usd, E_ready and reference_class are null on purpose: Llull fills them from measured reference classes.
